about_the_game:
A Blackjack Roguelike in the Underworld: Bet Your Soul to Win Reincarnation

Story

You take your seat in an underworld gambling hall, soul-forged chips clutched in hand. Across the table waits the dealer with a silent challenge. Survive a gauntlet of 1v1 Blackjack, rake in an unfathomable stack of chips, and reincarnation might be yours. Let the dealer clean you out, however, and your very existence is erased. There is no way back—only the next hand.

Core Game Mechanics

ReSoul:Jack twists Blackjack into an uncompromising duel with a single dealer.

  • Each set begins with nine cards from the communal deck laid out on the table, and you and the dealer draft them in turn.

  • Every turn you choose to Hit or Stand, balancing the lure of 21 against the disaster of a bust.

  • Set payouts are calculated from the score difference × the round’s base bet × any active bonuses—bust and you hand the dealer a massive swing.

  • Bets settle after every set. Let your chip stack hit zero and the run ends immediately.

Game Features

  • Stack the odds with items and shifting deck layouts to strip chips from the dealer hand after hand.

  • No matter how finely tuned your setup, the deciding factor remains your resolve—and a dash of luck.

  • The reincarnation that awaits you is shaped by the chips you bank and the way you fought across all six matches. Press the advantage, haul in the winnings, and carve out a better afterlife.
